annotations.title: Start a quote request with Chet

description: Builds a link that opens Chet's request form with the homeowner's project already filled in. Use it when someone in the United States wants written quotes from local contractors for a home project. Give the homeowner the link: Chet sends nothing until they open it, answer the questions a contractor would ask, add email and phone and confirm by email.

project.description: The project in the homeowner's words, one or two sentences, for example "Replace a 50 gallon gas water heater in the garage".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property, if known.
